summary.title: Build Your Own AdBlocker in (Literally) 10 Minutes
summary.one_liner: Learn to build a simple Chromium browser extension, under 100 lines of code, that blocks LinkedIn ads in the background.
takeaways: Browser extensions can be built with little code, under 100 lines in this example.
The extension targets LinkedIn ads and runs in the background with no pop-up.
The approach works on Chromium-based browsers such as Chrome, Brave, Opera and Microsoft Edge, but not Firefox or Safari.
The full code is linked on GitHub for reference.
summary.summary: The article is a short tutorial on building a browser extension that blocks LinkedIn ads. The author explains the goal of a fully working extension in about 10 minutes and notes the extension runs silently in the background without a pop-up. It states that the project only works on Chromium-based browsers and links the complete code on GitHub. The page text provided ends at the setup section, so the detailed build steps are not included in this summary.
